notes.title: 🐾 THE TRAILER FOR SECRET PAWS - COZY APARTMENTS IS NOW LIVE! 🎥✨
notes.content:
Hey, cat hunters! 🐱🏠

The official trailer for Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments is finally here! 🎬🔥
Get a first look at this 3D hidden objects adventure, where your mission is to find over 1000 hidden cats in cozy, cluttered apartments full of secrets! 🔍

Open drawers 🗄️, peek inside cabinets 🚪, move objects 📦, and uncover the most unexpected hiding spots. Every room holds surprises — and a few mysterious cats you won’t see coming! 😻

🌟 Add Secret Paws - Cozy Apartments to your Steam wishlist to stay up to date with all the news!

But wait — there’s more! 🎮 A free demo with an exclusive level is in the works, so you’ll soon be able to try the game before launch. Stay tuned! 😺🧩

🐾 Have you watched the trailer yet? Tell us what you think! 💬✨
